name: ASTRONOMY
blurb: OBSERVATIONS AN' SPACE MISSIONS, EACH FIGURE QUOTED WIT DA INSTRUMENT BEHIND IT!

astro_wmap.name: WMAP COSMIC AGE
astro_wmap.desc: FROM A LISSAJOUS ORBIT ABOUT DA EARTH-SUN L2 POINT, TWO BACK-TA-BACK GREGORIAN TELESCOPES FEED DIFFERENTIAL RADIOMETERS IN FIVE BANDS FROM 23 TA 94 GIGAHERTZ, MEASURIN' TEMPERATURE DIFFERENCES OF TENS OF MICROKELVIN ACROSS DA FULL SKY WHILE DA SPACECRAFT SPINS AN' PRECESSES TA CANCEL SYSTEMATICS. DA ANGULAR POWER SPECTRUM SHOWS DA FIRST ACOUSTIC PEAK AT MULTIPOLE 220 AN' TWO MORE BEYOND IT. DA SIX-PARAMETER FIT GIVES AN AGE OF 13.7 BILLION YEARS TA ONE PERCENT, A FLAT GEOMETRY, AN' A BUDGET OF 4.6 PERCENT BARYONS, 23 PERCENT DARK MATTER AN' DA REST DARK ENERGY!

astro_mars_rovers.name: SPIRIT AN' OPPORTUNITY
astro_mars_rovers.desc: TWO 180-KILOGRAM SOLAR ROVERS ENTER AT 5.4 KILOMETRES PER SECOND, DECELERATE UNDER A SUPERSONIC PARACHUTE, FIRE RETROROCKETS AN' BOUNCE TA REST INSIDE AIRBAG CLUSTERS AT GUSEV AN' MERIDIANI, IN OPPOSITE HEMISPHERES. EACH CARRIES A ROCK ABRASION TOOL DAT GRINDS FIVE MILLIMETRES INTO A FACE, AN ALPHA PARTICLE X-RAY SPECTROMETER FOR ELEMENTAL COMPOSITION AN' A MOESSBAUER SPECTROMETER FOR IRON MINERALOGY. OPPORTUNITY FINDS HEMATITE CONCRETIONS AN' JAROSITE, A SULPHATE DAT REQUIRES LIQUID WATER BELOW PH 4 TA FORM. DA DESIGN LIFE IZ 90 SOLS; OPPORTUNITY OPERATES FOR FOURTEEN YEARS!

astro_deep_impact.name: DEEP IMPACT
astro_deep_impact.desc: A 370-KILOGRAM IMPACTOR, LARGELY COPPER SO AS NO TA CONTAMINATE DA SPECTRA, IZ RELEASED 24 HOURS OUT AN' MANOEUVRES ITSELF INTO DA PATH OF COMET TEMPEL 1, STRIKIN' AT 10.3 KILOMETRES PER SECOND FOR A KINETIC YIELD NEAR 19 GIGAJOULES. DA FLYBY BUS IMAGES AN' SPECTROSCOPES DA PLUME FROM 500 KILOMETRES AN' IZ DEN SHIELDED AGAINST DA COMA. DA EJECTA RISE SLOWLY AN' FALL BACK IN A CURVE DAT IMPLIES A NUCLEUS OF ALMOST NO TENSILE STRENGTH AN' 75 PERCENT POROSITY, MADE OF MICRON-SCALE SILICATE GRAINS, WATER ICE AN' ORGANICS!

astro_titan.name: HUYGENS LANDS ON TITAN
astro_titan.desc: HUYGENS SEPARATES FROM CASSINI, COASTS FOR TWENTY DAYS AN' ENTERS TITAN'S ATMOSPHERE AT SIX KILOMETRES PER SECOND, DECELERATIN' TA MACH 1.5 IN UNDER THREE MINUTES BEFORE THREE SUCCESSIVE PARACHUTES TAKE IT DOWN OVER TWO HOURS AN' TWENTY-SEVEN MINUTES. A GAS CHROMATOGRAPH MASS SPECTROMETER PROFILES A NITROGEN ATMOSPHERE WIT A FEW PERCENT METHANE, AN' DA DESCENT IMAGER RETURNS DENDRITIC DRAINAGE NETWORKS CUT INTO BRIGHT TERRAIN. IT LANDS AT FIVE METRES PER SECOND ON DAMP GRANULAR GROUND AT 94 KELVIN, AN' TRANSMITS FOR A FURTHER SEVENTY MINUTES UNTIL CASSINI DROPS BELOW DA HORIZON!

astro_pluto.name: DWARF PLANET RECLASSIFICATION
astro_pluto.desc: DA DISCOVERY OF ERIS, OF COMPARABLE DIAMETER AN' 27 PERCENT GREATER MASS, FORCES DA QUESTION OF WHAT IZ TA BE COUNTED. RESOLUTION 5A OF DA IAU GENERAL ASSEMBLY DEFINES A PLANET BY THREE CLAUSES: IT ORBITS DA SUN, ITS SELF-GRAVITY HAB PULLED IT INTO HYDROSTATIC EQUILIBRIUM, AN' IT HAB CLEARED DA NEIGHBOURHOOD OF ITS ORBIT. PLUTO SATISFIES DA FIRST TWO, AN' BY DA SOTER PARAMETER ITS ORBITAL ZONE HOLDS SOME TEN THOUSAND TIMES ITS OWN MASS IN OTHER BODIES, SO IT IZ PLACED IN DA NEW CATEGORY OF DWARF PLANET!

astro_stardust.name: STARDUST SAMPLE RETURN
astro_stardust.desc: A COLLECTOR OF SILICA AEROGEL AT 0.01 GRAMS PER CUBIC CENTIMETRE, DEPLOYED AS A 0.1 SQUARE METRE GRID, IZ FLOWN THROUGH DA COMA OF COMET WILD 2 AT 6.1 KILOMETRES PER SECOND AN' STOPS DA GRAINS OVER SEVERAL CENTIMETRES OF TRACK WITHOUT VAPORISIN' DEM. DA CAPSULE RETURNS AN' RE-ENTERS AT 12.9 KILOMETRES PER SECOND, DA FASTEST OF ANY HUMAN-MADE OBJECT. DA GRAINS INCLUDE FORSTERITE, ANORTHITE AN' DA CALCIUM-ALUMINIUM-RICH INCLUSION INTI, MINERALS DAT CONDENSE ABOVE 1,400 KELVIN, SO MATERIAL FORMED NEAR DA SUN WAZ TRANSPORTED OUTWARD ACROSS DA DISK BEFORE DA COMET ACCRETED!

astro_exo_image.name: FIRST EXOPLANET IMAGE
astro_exo_image.desc: A DEFORMABLE MIRROR CORRECTS DA ATMOSPHERIC WAVEFRONT AT OVER A KILOHERTZ WHILE A CORONAGRAPH SUPPRESSES DA ON-AXIS STARLIGHT, AN' ANGULAR DIFFERENTIAL IMAGIN' ROTATES DA FIELD AGAINST DA FIXED INSTRUMENT PATTERN SO DA RESIDUAL SPECKLES CAN BE SUBTRACTED. THREE COMPANIONS OF HR 8799 IZ RESOLVED IN DA NEAR INFRARED AT CONTRASTS NEAR TEN TA DA MINUS FIVE AN' SEPARATIONS OF 24, 38 AN' 68 ASTRONOMICAL UNITS. DEY COMMON PROPER MOTION CONFIRMS DEY IZ BOUND, AN' DEY ORBITAL ARCS IZ DEN FOLLOWED FRAME TA FRAME OVER DA FOLLOWIN' YEARS!

astro_water_moon.name: WATER ON DA MOON
astro_water_moon.desc: A SPENT CENTAUR UPPER STAGE OF 2,300 KILOGRAMS IZ AIMED INTO DA PERMANENTLY SHADOWED FLOOR OF CABEUS, NEAR DA LUNAR SOUTH POLE, WHERE DA SURFACE HAB NO SEEN SUNLIGHT FOR TWO BILLION YEARS AN' SITS BELOW 40 KELVIN. IT EXCAVATES SOME 350 TONNES OF REGOLITH, AN' DA SHEPHERDIN' SPACECRAFT FLIES THROUGH DA PLUME FOUR MINUTES BEHIND, MEASURIN' NEAR-INFRARED WATER ABSORPTION BEFORE IT STRIKES IN TURN. DA PLUME IZ 5.6 PERCENT WATER ICE BY MASS, WIT HYDROXYL, CARBON MONOXIDE, AMMONIA AN' MERCURY ALONGSIDE IT!

astro_kepler.name: KEPLER TELESCOPE LAUNCH
astro_kepler.desc: A 0.95 METRE SCHMIDT TELESCOPE IN AN EARTH-TRAILIN' HELIOCENTRIC ORBIT STARES AT A SINGLE 115 SQUARE DEGREE FIELD IN CYGNUS AN' LYRA WITHOUT SLEWIN', READIN' 42 CCDS AT A THIRTY MINUTE CADENCE FOR 150,000 TARGET STARS. DA PHOTOMETRY IZ DELIBERATELY DEFOCUSED ACROSS SEVERAL PIXELS AN' CALIBRATED PER PIXEL, HOLDIN' DIFFERENTIAL PRECISION NEAR 20 PARTS PER MILLION OVER SIX HOURS. AN EARTH-RADIUS PLANET CROSSIN' A SOLAR-RADIUS STAR DIMS IT BY 84 PARTS PER MILLION FOR A FEW HOURS ONCE A YEAR, SO DA SIGNAL EXISTS ONLY IF DAT NOISE FLOOR HOLDS FOR DA WHOLE MISSION!

astro_dawn_vesta.name: DAWN ORBITS VESTA
astro_dawn_vesta.desc: THREE XENON ION THRUSTERS DELIVER 90 MILLINEWTONS AT A SPECIFIC IMPULSE OF 3,100 SECONDS, AN' RUNNIN' DEM FOR YEARS ACCUMULATES MORE DEN 11 KILOMETRES PER SECOND OF DELTA-V ON 425 KILOGRAMS OF PROPELLANT, ENOUGH FOR ONE SPACECRAFT TA ENTER ORBIT ABOUT A MAIN BELT BODY AN' LATER LEAVE IT FOR A SECOND. FRAMIN' CAMERAS, A VISIBLE AN' INFRARED SPECTROMETER AN' A GAMMA-RAY AN' NEUTRON DETECTOR MAP VESTA OVER FOURTEEN MONTHS: DA RHEASILVIA BASIN COVERS MOST OF DA SOUTHERN HEMISPHERE, DA HOWARDITE-EUCRITE-DIOGENITE METEORITES IZ MATCHED TA ITS CRUST, AN' DA GRAVITY FIELD CONFIRMS AN IRON CORE!

astro_habitable.name: FIRST HABITABLE-ZONE WORLD
astro_habitable.desc: KEPLER-22B IZ CONFIRMED ON THREE TRANSITS GIVIN' A PERIOD OF 289.9 DAYS ABOUT A G5 STAR SLIGHTLY COOLER DEN DA SUN. DA TRANSIT DEPTH CORRESPONDS TA 2.4 EARTH RADII, AN' DA INCIDENT FLUX IZ 1.1 TIMES TERRESTRIAL, PLACIN' IT INSIDE DA CONSERVATIVE HABITABLE ZONE. TRANSIT PHOTOMETRY CONSTRAINS RADIUS AN' PERIOD ALONE: DA RADIAL VELOCITY AMPLITUDE IZ BELOW DA DETECTION LIMIT, SO DA MASS IZ CAPPED RATHER DEN MEASURED, AN' AT DAT RADIUS DA OBJECT IZ AS LIKELY TA BE A MINI-NEPTUNE WIT A HYDROGEN ENVELOPE AS A ROCKY WORLD!

astro_curiosity.name: CURIOSITY LANDS ON MARS
astro_curiosity.desc: A 900-KILOGRAM ROVER IZ PAST DA MASS AT WHICH AIRBAGS WORK. DA CRUISE STAGE ENTERS AT 5.8 KILOMETRES PER SECOND, FLIES A GUIDED LIFTIN' ENTRY DAT TRIMS DA ELLIPSE TA 20 BY 7 KILOMETRES, DEPLOYS A 21.5 METRE PARACHUTE AT MACH 1.7, AN' DA DESCENT STAGE DEN THROTTLES EIGHT ENGINES TA HOLD A HOVER AT 0.75 METRES PER SECOND WHILE DA ROVER IZ WINCHED OUT ON SEVEN AN' A HALF METRE BRIDLES. TOUCHDOWN IZ READ FROM DA THROTTLE FIDDLY BIT, DA BRIDLES IZ CUT AN' DA STAGE FLIES CLEAR TA CRASH. POWER IZ 110 WATTS FROM A RADIOISOTOPE GENERATOR; DA PAYLOAD INCLUDES A LASER-INDUCED BREAKDOWN SPECTROMETER, AN X-RAY DIFFRACTOMETER AN' A SAMPLE OVEN!

astro_face_mars.name: DA FACE ON MARS
astro_face_mars.desc: VIKIN' ORBITER 1 FRAME 35A72, ACQUIRED AT 43 METRES PER PIXEL WIT DA SUN 20 DEGREES ABOVE DA HORIZON, SHOWS A MESA IN CYDONIA IN WHICH SHADOW FILLS DA DEPRESSIONS SYMMETRICALLY; A DROPPED DATA BIT ADDS DA DARK SPOT READ AS A NOSTRIL. MARS GLOBAL SURVEYOR RE-IMAGES DA SAME LANDFORM TWICE AT UP TA 1.56 METRES PER PIXEL AN' AT HIGH SUN, AN' MARS EXPRESS RETURNS A STEREO DIGITAL TERRAIN MODEL OF IT. DA FEATURE IZ AN ERODED MASSIF OF DA KIND DAT OCCURS IN HUNDREDS ACROSS DA REGION!

astro_nibiru.name: NIBIRU AN' DA DOOMSDAY PERIHELION
astro_nibiru.desc: A BODY OF PLANETARY MASS IZ PLACED ON A 3,600 YEAR ECCENTRIC ORBIT WIT PERIHELION TIMED TA DA END OF DA THIRTEENTH BAKTUN. AN OBJECT OF DAT MASS ARRIVIN' WITHIN MONTHS WOULD ALREADY BE AT NAKED-EYE MAGNITUDE AN' MOVIN' DETECTABLY AGAINST DA FIELD, WOULD HAB SHOWN IN EVERY INFRARED ALL-SKY SURVEY SINCE IRAS, AN' WOULD LEAVE A RESIDUAL IN DA EPHEMERIDES OF URANUS, NEPTUNE AN' DA CASSINI RANGIN' TA SATURN. DOZE EPHEMERIDES IZ FITTED TA TENS OF METRES AN' REQUIRE NO SUCH TERM!

astro_ancient_astronauts.name: DA ANCIENT ASTRONAUT HYPOTHESIS
astro_ancient_astronauts.desc: A READIN' IN WHICH MEGALITHIC CONSTRUCTION, ASTRONOMICAL ALIGNMENT AN' CREATION MYTH IZ ALL PRODUCTS OF A VISITIN' TECHNOLOGY. IT REQUIRES DA SURVIVIN' EVIDENCE OF TERRESTRIAL CONSTRUCTION TA BE SET ASIDE: DA ABANDONED QUARRIES WIT DA BLOCKS STILL ATTACHED, DA COPPER AN' DOLERITE TOOL MARKS MATCHED TA DOZE BLOCKS, DA RAMPS, DA SPOIL HEAPS, DA WORKERS' VILLAGES, DA RATION RECORDS AN' DA RECONSTRUCTIONS CARRIED OUT WIT PERIOD TOOLS. IT PREDICTS NO ARTEFACT, NO ALLOY AN' NO STRATUM, AN' EVERY CLAIM IT ADVANCES IZ AN ARGUMENT FROM INCREDULITY ABOUT LABOUR!

astro_photometry.name: PRECISION TRANSIT PHOTOMETRY
astro_photometry.desc: A TERRESTRIAL TRANSIT IZ A DIMMIN' OF ONE PART IN TEN THOUSAND LASTIN' HOURS, AN ORDER OF MAGNITUDE BELOW DA FLAT-FIELD RESIDUALS, POINTIN' JITTER AN' THERMAL DRIFT OF AN ORDINARY PHOTOMETER. DA SIGNAL IZ RECOVERED DIFFERENTIALLY, AGAINST AN ENSEMBLE OF COMPARISON STARS ON DA SAME DETECTOR SO DAT COMMON-MODE TERMS DIVIDE OUT; DA POINT SPREAD FUNCTION IZ SPREAD OVER MANY PIXELS TA AVERAGE RESPONSE VARIATION; AN' DA PER-PIXEL GAIN MAP IZ HELD STABLE TA PARTS PER MILLION FOR YEARS, WIT DA RESIDUAL DRIFT REMOVED BY FITTIN' COTRENDIN' BASIS VECTORS DERIVED FROM DA ENSEMBLE ITSELF!

astro_rtg.name: RADIOISOTOPE POWER SUPPLY
astro_rtg.desc: EIGHT GENERAL PURPOSE HEAT SOURCE MODULES HOLD 4.8 KILOGRAMS OF PLUTONIUM-238 DIOXIDE, WHOSE 87.7 YEAR HALF-LIFE YIELDS ABOUT TWO KILOWATTS OF DECAY HEAT. DAT HEAT CROSSES 768 THERMOCOUPLES OF LEAD TELLURIDE AN' SKUTTERUDITE ARRANGED IN SERIES-PARALLEL, AN' DA SEEBECK VOLTAGE DELIVERS ROUGHLY 110 WATTS AT 28 VOLTS, FOR A CONVERSION EFFICIENCY NEAR SIX PERCENT. OUTPUT FALLS ABOUT 1.6 PERCENT A YEAR THROUGH DECAY AN' THERMOCOUPLE DEGRADATION, AN' IT IZ INDEPENDENT OF DUST LOADIN', SEASON, LATITUDE AN' NIGHT, WHICH NO SOLAR ARRAY ON MARS IZ!

astro_skycrane.name: DA SKY CRANE REHEARSAL
astro_skycrane.desc: A ONE-TONNE ROVER NO CAN BE SET DOWN BY DA AIRBAG METHOD, WHICH TOPS OUT NEAR 200 KILOGRAMS OF LANDED MASS, AN' LEGS LONG ENOUGH TA CLEAR DA TERRAIN UNDER IT WOULD STAND HIGHER DEN ITS OWN WHEELBASE AN' PUT DA DECK OUT OF REACH OF DA ARM. DA DESCENT STAGE INSTEAD STOPS ABOVE DA SURFACE ON EIGHT THROTTLEABLE 3,000 NEWTON ENGINES, KEEPS DA PLUME AN' ITS DUST AWAY FROM DA VEHICLE, AN' LOWERS DA ROVER ON THREE NYLON BRIDLES AN' AN UMBILICAL. TOUCHDOWN IZ DETECTED AS A DROP IN COMMANDED THROTTLE; DA BRIDLES IZ PYROTECHNICALLY CUT AN' DA STAGE DEPARTS ON DA REMAININ' PROPELLANT!
